{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df = trial_df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_value = -999.0
sentinel_count = (severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()

# Drop sentinel values before computing the mean
severe_df_clean = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients (excluding sentinels)
mean_biomarker_severe_clean = severe_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_severe_clean"}
